referencePolicy: Prompts and reference inputs record the initial generation history. The published originals are the latest user-supplied revisions; their subsequent editing or generation process is not inferred. Web copies preserve native resolution and continuous grayscale tones with lossless encoding.

artworks.name: cover
artworks.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Original illustration for the cover of the RANDOM tabletop roleplaying rulebook.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES, not images to reproduce: castle entry.jpg supplies architectural linework; young guy.jpg supplies energetic figure drafting; male driad.jpg supplies invented fantasy physiognomy; adventurer & monster.jpg supplies narrative depth and hatching. Match the actual visual references closely; the visual references take precedence over the written description wherever they differ. Do not copy any composition, character identity, signature, handwriting, watermark, or distinctive ornament.
Scene: an unlikely small company of three freely invented travelers pause at an ancient broken stone gateway and look out towards a distant winding path and a fantastical town. A wiry traveler in a practical patched cloak with a lantern, a short stocky companion carrying a bundle of miscellaneous gear, and a slender bark-featured wanderer. No uniforms, class labels, fixed lore, recognizable IP, or game mechanics. Evoke curiosity and open-ended adventure, not a battle poster.
Composition: landscape 3:2, intricate gateway and travelers arranged along the lower two thirds, open quiet pale paper in the upper third, distant architecture sketched lightly through the opening; varied human-scale silhouettes, diagonal depth, visually rich but airy. This is artwork only; typography will be laid out separately. Natural sketch edges dissolve into clean warm off-white paper on all sides, especially the upper edge. No rectangular frame or scene border.
Style/medium: Traditional hand-drawn fantasy illustration, reminiscent of an illustrator's pencil studies for a classic tabletop RPG rulebook. Graphite pencil and fine ink on warm, off-white paper. Predominantly monochromatic with natural graphite grays and subtle sepia tones. Loose, confident, expressive linework, visible construction lines, overlapping strokes, varied line weight, irregular contours, and organic imperfections. Detailed cross-hatching and directional pencil shading. Some areas carefully rendered while others remain deliberately unfinished. Authentic traditional sketchbook aesthetic, visibly handmade. No watercolor, painted color fills, digital gradients, airbrushing, photorealism, polished digital concept art, or 3D rendering.
No lettering, labels, numbers, signature, logos, or watermark. Keep the reference images' lively draftsmanship and unusual character of the lines; avoid generic smooth AI fantasy illustration.

revision.preparation: Native resolution, neutral continuous grayscale, lossless WebP. No resampling, sharpening, thresholding or dithering. Soft edge blending is applied by the shared stylesheet.
